title: opulus oxycoccos
intro: Opulus oxycoccos, commonly known as the cranberry or bog cranberry, is a low-growing, deciduous shrub native to acidic wetlands in northern Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing the risk of urinary tract infections due to its proanthocyanidin content, which helps prevent bacterial adhesion to bladder and urinary tract walls. The therapeutic actions of Opulus oxycoccos include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and proanthocyanidins, contributing to its medicinal properties and potential uses.
